hotspots.title: Trump administration’s Iran economic warfare escalation
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced sweeping new sanctions targeting Iran's economy, including entities and individuals supporting Tehran. This move, termed 'economic D-Day,' aims to cripple Iran's revenue sources and pressure it to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes geopolitical tensions, potential global economic repercussions, and the administration's aggressive stance on foreign policy.

hotspots.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei faces mounting criticism over his economic policies, including rising household debt and inflation. His government is pushing key reforms in Congress while dealing with internal conflicts and declining youth support.
hotspots.affect: This story is charged due to the intense public dissatisfaction with economic conditions, Milei's confrontational rhetoric, and the high stakes of upcoming legislative battles.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading in polls for upcoming state elections, proposing radical policies such as leaving the Eurozone, ending Schengen, and mass deportations. The party's rise is sparking debates about democratic backsliding and extremism.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to fears of democratic erosion, historical parallels to fascism, and the AfD's controversial policies on migration and climate change.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration plans to revoke up to 200,000 visas from asylum seekers, marking the largest mass visa revocation in U.S. history. This move is part of a broader crackdown on immigration, including new H-1B visa fees and stricter mail-in voting rules.
hotspots.affect: This story is highly charged due to its humanitarian implications, legal controversies, and the administration's hardline stance on immigration.

hotspots.title: Reform UK’s social housing overhaul controversy
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK has proposed radical changes to social housing policies, including prioritizing British-born tenants and evicting foreign nationals. The party's plans have sparked debates about xenophobia, housing shortages, and welfare reform.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its divisive nature, potential impact on vulnerable populations, and the party's hardline stance on immigration and welfare.
